title: SB1498 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-02-02; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514155143 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB1498.pdf (LegiScan doc 2677265))
provenance.note: Draft of 2023-02-02 (as introduced); amendments not in text. Section 4 quote stops at a page break; the rest covers school-property parking areas, with an exception for persons at least 18 who meet military-service qualifications. Twin: TN-HB-1158-2023.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)(1)): (1) The person is at least eighteen (18) years of age;
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1351(b)): If the applicant is at least eighteen (18) years of age and is not prohibited from possessing a firearm in this state pursuant to § 39-17-1307(b), 18 U.S.C. § 922(g), or any other state or federal law, and the applicant otherwise meets all of the requirements of this section, the department shall issue a permit to the applicant.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1351(x)(1)): is amended by deleting the language "twenty-one (21) years of age" and substituting instead the language "eighteen (18) years of age".
SECTION 4 (new TCA 39-17-1313(e)): (e) Notwithstanding subsection (a), this section does not apply to a person who is under twenty-one (21) years of age and transports or stores a firearm or firearm ammunition in the person's motor vehicle while on or utilizing a public or private parking
